# dsh-ncm-plugin
> **中文文档**：README.zh-CN.md
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that wraps the ncm-cli NetEase Cloud Music command-line tool as model-call
Harness plugin that wraps the ncm-cli NetEase Cloud Music command-line tool as model-callable tools.

## What it is
`dsh-ncm-plugin` exposes NetEase Cloud Music CLI capabilities to DSH agents: account s
tatus, playlists, songs, lyrics, playable URLs, daily recommendations, play records, search, and pla
ylist management/cleanup — all through structured, JSON-backed tools.

## Features
- Account: login status, current user, version.
- Playlists: list/show/create/add/remove

/rename/tags/desc/delete.
- Playlist tidy: inspect, filter, diff, apply, move, duplicates.
- Songs:

metadata, lyrics, playable URL resolution, desktop playback.
- Discovery: daily recommendations, wee

kly/all play records.
- Search: suggestions, songs, playlists.
- Safe by default: destructive writes

require explicit confirmation.
- JSON-first output for agents, readable text rendering for the UI.

- Built-in Web Settings panel: every tool is exposed as an auto-generated
form (account, playlists,
tidy, search, song/lyric/URL, recommendations).

## Use cases
- Ask the agent "what's in my playlist 490155105?"
- Search for songs and add them to a

playlist.
- Clean up duplicate songs in a large playlist.
- Look up lyrics and playable URLs.
- Che
ck daily recommendations and play history.
See docs/用例目录/README.md for the full command/use-case/parameter catalog (Chinese).

## Installation
### Preconditions
- Node.js 22+, `dsh` CLI installed (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`).
-

No preinstalled `ncm` CLI is required. The plugin auto-downloads the
platform release binary into `

$DSH_HOME/bin` on first tool run, or when you
click **Install/update ncm** in the UI. Download order

: `ghfast.top` →
`gh-proxy.com` → GitHub official, so mainland-China networks use mirrors
first. Pla
ywright driver downloads use `npmmirror.com` by default.
